My research focuses on language technologies, intelligent systems, trustworthy AI, and the adoption of AI in real-world settings. ::: {.scholar-note} For a complete list of publications, see my [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=uHGhCAgAAAAJ&hl=en). ::: ::: {.research-grid} ::: {.research-card} My research focuses on Arabic and multilingual language technologies, with particular interest in morphology, tokenization, conversational AI, diacritic restoration, and language model evaluation.
Selected Recent Publications - **Morphemes Without Borders: Evaluating Root-Pattern Morphology in Arabic Tokenizers and LLMs** [LREC 2026]{.venue} - **Beyond Fertility: Analyzing STRR as a Metric for Multilingual Tokenization Evaluation** [NeurIPS 2025 Workshop]{.venue} - **Injecting Domain Knowledge in Language Models for Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems** [EMNLP 2022]{.venue} - **Using Optimal Transport as an Alignment Objective for Fine-Tuning Multilingual Contextualized Embeddings** [EMNLP 2021]{.venue}
::: ::: {.research-card} ### Speech & Spoken Language Technologies My research focuses on technologies for understanding, generating, and evaluating spoken language, with particular interest in speech recognition, text-to-speech, speech data, and the interaction between speech and language processing.
Selected Recent Publications - **Data Augmentation for Speech-Based Diacritic Restoration** [ANLP 2024]{.venue} - **Automatic Restoration of Diacritics for Speech Datasets** [NAACL 2024]{.venue}
::: ::: {.research-card} ### Foundation Models & Intelligent Systems My research explores the development, adaptation, and evaluation of foundation models and intelligent systems, including LLMs, generative AI, and AI agents.
Selected Recent Publications - **Stop Taking Tokenizers for Granted: They Are Core Design Decisions in Large Language Models** [EACL 2026]{.venue} - **A Systematic Survey and Critical Review on Evaluating Large Language Models: Challenges, Limitations, and Recommendations** [EMNLP 2024]{.venue} - **Morphemes Without Borders: Evaluating Root-Pattern Morphology in Arabic Tokenizers and LLMs** [LREC 2026]{.venue}
::: ::: {.research-card} ### Trustworthy & Responsible AI My research focuses on the reliability, safety, security, and responsible development of AI systems, with particular interest in red teaming, robustness, vulnerability assessment, and responsible AI evaluation.
Selected Recent Publications [Coming soon.]{.pubs-empty}
::: ::: {.research-card} ### AI Transformation & Domain Applications AI readiness, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, and applications of AI in areas such as HR, education, healthcare, and industry.
Selected Recent Publications [Coming soon.]{.pubs-empty}
::: :::
